pages.title: Particle Spectrometer
pages.text: Separates a spray of particles by mass and charge: quark flavours, leptons and gauge bosons, one by one.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Real spectrometers work on the same idea: a magnetic field bends a charged particle's path, and how sharply it curves gives away its momentum and charge. Light particles swing wide, heavy ones barely turn. Mine sorts the spray into labelled bins.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 3 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Gauge Boson Cluster, Lepton Triplet, Strange & Charm Quarks, Strange Matter, Up & Down Quarks.
